title: Verifying Text-to-SQL Queries under Changing Business Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2610.41090v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In text-to-SQL and AI-agent analytics, successful SQL execution does not establish semantic correctness under changing business definitions. We study revalidation of fixed queries after changes to refund attribution, tax treatment, eligible populations and exchange-rate dates. An executable verification profile binds the requested revision and knowledge cutoff to legal counterexample data and exact monetary comparison. A preregistered confirmation on 32 newly authored revision families and two local producer bundles retains 192 query-definition cells: 144 nonconforming, 36 finite-suite agreeing and 12 unresolved. Of the nonconforming cells, 63 agree on the current snapshot. At an eight-ledger budget, obligation-guided checking detects 137 discrepancies versus 127 for generic ordering, a paired difference of 6.9 percentage points (family bootstrap 95% interval [2.1, 13.6]; exact family sign-flip p=0.0156). translated_title: 在业务语义变化下验证Text-to-SQL查询
translated_abstract: 在text-to-SQL（文本转SQL）和AI代理分析中，SQL成功执行并不能确立其在业务定义变化下的语义正确性。我们研究了在退款归属、税务处理、符合条件人群以及汇率日期发生变化后，对固定查询的重新验证问题。我们提出的可执行验证配置文件将所请求的修订与知识截止日期绑定到合法的反例数据和精确的货币比较上。一项预注册的确认实验在32个新编写的修订族和两个本地生产者捆绑包上保留了192个查询-定义单元格：其中144个不符合、36个有限测试套件一致、12个未解决。在不符合的单元格中，有63个在当前快照上一致。在八分类账预算下，义务引导的检查检测出137个差异，而通用排序方法检测出127个，配对差异为6.9个百分点（族自助法95%置信区间[2.1, 13.6]；精确族符号翻转检验p=0.0156）。每个分类账臂均拒绝零个……（原文摘要似有截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在业务语义（如退款归属、税务处理等）发生变化后重新验证Text-to-SQL查询的可执行验证框架，其义务引导的检查方法在检测语义差异方面比通用排序方法显著高出6.9个百分点。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an executable verification framework for revalidating text-to-SQL queries after changes in business semantics (e.g., refund attribution, tax treatment), showing that obligation-guided checking detects 6.9 percentage points more semantic discrepancies than generic ordering.
